creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The bridge reports `bridge.painted` on the leading edge only (at most every 250ms, and only when a frame arrives). Frames inside the interval are held until the next frame, so the echo of the last keystrokes before a pause is never reported, and the core raises `pane:<key>:painting` 10s later. The next keystroke clears it. The `bridge.frames` debug summary has the same defect.

Seen on local/p23f0s2f1p: last keystroke 22:26:10.255, raised 22:26:20.108, the next keystroke's report at 22:26:27.226 carried the 9 held frames.

Fix: a trailing report, so held frames get their line once the interval ends even when no further frame arrives.
title: 🎯 Pausing after typing raises a false painting-stopped warning
